sections.what_is_sickle_cell_anemia: Sickle cell anemia is a blood disorder and inherited form of anemia. In this condition red blood cells become sticky and rigid and form a crescent shape, like a sickle cell. These sickle red blood cells get stick to the wall of blood vessels and block the blood flow and oxygen to various parts of body. Normally, red blood cells are round and flexible which allow them to move easily through blood.
sections.symptoms_associated_with_sickle_cell_ane:
Anemia 
 Chest pain which results in difficulty in breathing 
 Abdominal pain. 
 Joint pain. 
 Swelling in hands and feet. 
 Slow growth and development in infants and children. 
 Delayed puberty in teenagers. 
 There is blockage of blood flow to spleen or liver. 

 WHEN TO VISIT YOUR DOCTOR? 
 Sickle cell anemia has the serious health hazards like permanent damage to brain, heart, liver, kidneys and bones. So it is mandatory to visit your doctor during these symptoms:- 

 Severe pain in abdomen, chest and joints. 
 People who have sickle cell anemia are at the increased risk of infections and fever is the first symptom. 
 Pale skin. 
 One side paralysis and weakness in arms, legs, difficulty in walking and problem in vision, then call your doctor immediately.
